rawInput.command:
cd /home/agent/workspace && ls -la migration.db && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('migration.db')
print('SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Integrity check:', con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
con.close()
"
rawInput.intent: Verify migration.db exists and is a valid SQLite database

rawInput.command:
cd /home/agent/workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('migration.db')
con.execute('VACUUM')  # writes the SQLite file header
con.commit()
con.close()
" && ls -la migration.db && file migration.db && head -c 16 migration.db | od -c | head -2
rawInput.intent: Initialize SQLite file header so migration.db is a fully formed database file
